confirmation.method: Project confirmFailures comparator with serialized full-file head/base reruns and fresh isolation for every file.

diagnosticAudit.normalization: Checkout paths; generated isolation and fixture identities, commit hashes, revision digests, PIDs and times with equality relationships preserved; explicitly labelled elapsed metrics. Assertion thresholds and their received elapsed values remain unchanged.

observations.assessment: The unchanged source has the same FileTransactionBusyError and message at both timeout checks; assertions and their expected/actual values match.

observations.assessment: The expected/received projection and all other failure details match after relational digest normalization.

observations.difference: The root-exits-before-helper case expects less than 5000 ms; head observed 5004 and main observed 5010.
observations.assessment: Both complete full-file samples fail the same elapsed-time assertion. These values remain unnormalized and neither sample is counted as passing evidence.

execution.environment: checkEnvironment followed by isolatedEnvironment(createGateSandbox(), env); closed Viewer control URL

notes: Each explicit file ran in its own owned gate process with fresh HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR and LLV_STATE_DIR.
The selection ran in two serialized batches of 117 and 42 unique files against identical source and baseline hashes; one cold full-project typecheck precedes both batches.
Every failing head file has a complete full-file baseline result. Matching baseline failures remain visible, and intermittent cases retain full-file confirmation outcomes.
Totals describe the initial complete selection; confirmation runs are listed separately.
Recorded-check custody receipts were not used; actual native exits and complete JUnit reports determine the results.

The original approval and prior-attempt regressions fail on unchanged main guards. The earlier 109-case native guard fixture has 14 failures before the review fixes; its digest identifies that fixture separately.

The final fixture also exercises the real repository pre-push and privacy gates. Its three selected hook cases yield two passes and one expected failure before the hook fix, then three passes after that fix.
